findings.text: normalize (lowering.normalize) consumes the reduce System IR, not Discretized/Descriptor; nondimensionalization for descriptor-producing anchors is the discretize unit-domain precondition. Descriptor lane enters the chain at scaling.

closure.projected (N=32) changes max|lambda| (4.096 -> 1.024); alpha/omega_max were derived on the FULL descriptor. Carrying the projected descriptor downstream requires RE-DERIVING scaling on it, else route_contract/p7 omega_max and P3 alpha split into two conventions. Chain carries the full descriptor + closure certificate as evidence.

interface consumes a physical field on the periodic grid, not the descriptor/modal coordinates; modal<->field plumbing (the representation transform T) is compiler work not yet wired. Minimal real input used: the anchor grid fields (smooth/step).

basis selection is not composed into scaling: p7's coefficient graph consumes scaling.scaled (RAW coordinates + P3 preconditioning, a_tol-thresholded), while route contracts / generate_config's coupling graph consume the descriptor passed in (here the basis winner's transformed A). When winner != identity these are DIFFERENT coordinate systems (contracts on 12 transformed edges vs 6 coeff edges on the raw graph); the compiler must compose T into the scaled descriptor before emitting coeff graph + contracts.
